'''Pampy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Pampy, a [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], was working in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] alongside [[Orn Free Taa's Twi'lek aide|another Lethan Twi'lek]] as [[Aide/Legends|aides]] to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]]. Between the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Lethan aide was replaced by [[Supi/Legends|Supi]]. Both were present at a [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] meeting that determined the protection of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] following an assassination attempt that delayed the vote on an army for the Republic.
